_comment: Provider registry. Edited from /admin, committed to this public repo like any method change. The web app never executes `command`; only the local Python pipeline does. See lib/providers.ts for the security boundary. Extractor order matters: the first enabled entry whose command resolves on PATH is the one that runs, and the run record stores which one it was.

providers.label: Claude (API)
providers.note: Default extractor. Declared conflict: it reads answers about its own products.

providers.label: Claude Code (local CLI)
providers.note: Primary extractor. Runs on this machine's subscription; no API credit, no key. Declared conflict: it reads answers about its own products.

providers.label: Codex (local CLI)
providers.note: Fallback, used when claude is not on PATH. Listed after claude-cli because the first enabled extractor that resolves is the one that runs. Costs no API credit; carries roughly 9k tokens of harness overhead per call.

providers.label: Claude Code (local)
providers.note: Own chart row, not a substitute for the hosted claude engine: this is a coding agent with a different system prompt, and it volunteers that it is made by Anthropic. Enabled, which means the weekly run must happen on this machine: see scripts/weekly-run.cmd.

providers.label: Codex (local)
providers.note: Own chart row, not a substitute for the hosted chatgpt engine. In testing it ranked Claude Code above OpenAI's own Codex. Enabled for the same reason as claude-code.
